description: This Java class is a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application, providing centralized handling of various exceptions and returning consistent error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring RestControllerAdvice class that manages global exception handling for the application, returning structured error responses.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles BadRequestException and returns a 400 BAD_REQUEST response with an error payload.

methods.name: handleUnprocessable
methods.description: Handles UnprocessableEntityException and returns a 422 response with an error payload.

methods.name: handleMaxSize
methods.description: Handles MaxUploadSizeExceededException and returns a 413 Payload Too Large response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions and returns a 500 Internal Server Error response.
